docs.title: 乾卦
docs.text:
《乾》 茎秆 (Stalk) - 井垣 (Bulwark)

元亨，利贞。 大通亨达，利于守持正固。 Great flourishing and free passage. It is favorable to remain upright and steadfast. 参考义项：上出，斗转/斡旋。

《象》曰：天行健，君子以自强不息。 自强：天道刚健运行，这就是乾。君子因此劝勉自己而不慰劳。 Self-Strengthening: The way of heaven moves with firm vigor; this is Qian. Therefore the noble one encourage oneself rather than console oneself.

初九：潜龙，勿用。 空乏：龙潜藏未出，此时不宜施用。 Depletion / Subact: The dragon lies hidden; it is not yet the time to put it to use.

九二：见龙在田，利见大人。 建立：龙已出现在田野之上，利于见大人。 Foundation / Act: The dragon has appeared in the field. It is favorable to see the people in high positions.

九三：君子终日乾乾，夕惕若。厉，无咎。 干求：君子整日勤勉奋发，到了夜晚仍警惕戒惧。虽有危险，终无咎害。 Aspiration / Enact: The noble one labors on vigorously all day and remains watchful into the night. There is danger, yet no blame.

九四：或跃在渊，无咎。 干犯：或可跃起于深渊，没有过错。 Encroachment / Transact: One may leap up from the deep. There is no blame.

九五：飞龙在天，利见大人。 治理：龙飞腾于天，利于见大人。 Governance / Coact: The dragon soars in heaven. It is favorable to see the great person.

上九：亢龙，有悔。 捍卫：倔强的龙，有悔。 Safeguarding / Overact: A stubborn dragon. There is regret.

用九：见群龙无首，吉。 通九 主管：看到群龙而无首领，吉。 All Nine (in Charge): One sees a host of dragons with no leader. This is auspicious.

docs.title: 同人卦
docs.text:
《同人》 严明 (Strictness) - 和平(Peace)

同人于野，亨。利涉大川。利君子贞。 在屋檐下随同他人，通达。利于涉过大河，利于君子守持正固。 Following others under the eaves, brings success. It is favorable to cross the great river, and favorable for the noble one to hold fast to what is upright. 参考义项：佣役。虽然不同，依然随同。

《象》曰：天与火，同人。君子以类族辨物。 辨类：天与火相与，这就是同人。君子以此遵循族属治理万物。 Discernment of Kinds: Heaven together with fire forms Tongren. Therefore the noble one governs things according to their clan affiliation..

初九：同人于门，无咎。 威重：在大门通告人，没有过错。 Gravity / Accord: One announces the people at the gate; there is no blame.

六二：同人于宗，吝。 通-交往：只在宗族施行亲仁，会有局促与憾惜。 Intercourse / Concord: If one practices kin-centered humaneness only within the clan, there will be constraint and regret.

九三：伏戎于莽，升其高陵，三岁不兴。 通-开辟：在草莽中驾驭兵车，要登上高陵，长久不能兴兵。 Pioneering / Discordance: One drives war chariots through the overgrowth and seeks to ascend the high ridge, yet for a long time cannot raise the troops.

九四：乘其墉，弗克攻，吉。 慎重：登上对方的城墙，却没能攻占，吉。 Prudence / Record: One climbs the other side's wall yet fails to capture it; this is auspicious.

九五：同人先号咷而后笑，大师克，相遇。 统一：聚集人，先有哭号，后有欢笑；大军克敌之后，终得相遇。 Unification / Coordinator: People are gathered; first there is crying out and weeping, then laughter. After the great army overcomes the enemy, they finally meet.

上九：同人于郊，无悔。 种-培植：在郊外操作锄头，没有悔恨。 Cultivation / Cardiac Transplant: One works the hoe in the outskirts; there is no regret.

docs.title: 大有卦
docs.text:
《大有》 待佑 (Leverage Support) - 大域 (Great Territory)

元亨。 大为通达。 Great flourishing and free passage. 参考义项：林囿，先有秩序之成，后成生息之盛。

《象》曰：火在天上，大有。君子以遏恶扬善，顺天休命。 明治：火在天上普照，这就是大有。君子用此抑止恶行，彰扬善行，顺应天道而帮助传达诰命。 Luminous Governance: Fire shines above heaven; this is Dayou. Therefore the noble one restrains what is harmful, exalts what is good, follows the way of heaven, and facilitates mandates.

初九：无交害匪咎。艰则无咎。 友-结交：不骄傲妒忌，本无过错；若能谨慎，更可免咎。 Affiliation / Obtain: If one is neither arrogant nor jealous, there is originally no fault; if one can remain cautious, one can avoid blame all the more. 希腊文图式：philos 英文直译：friend / beloved

九二：大车以载，有攸往，无咎。 占有：用大车来装载，有所前往，没有过错。 Exhortation / Contain: A great wagon is used to bear the load; there is a place to go, and no blame.

九三：公用亨于天子，小人弗克。 侑-劝勉：天子宴请，公侯享用，小人则不能如此。 Exhortation / Sustain: The Son of Heaven hosts the feast, and the lords partake of it; a petty person cannot do so.

九四：匪其彭，无咎。 囿-设界：区分近旁，没有过错。 Demarcation / Detain: One distinguishes who is near, and there is no blame.

六五：厥孚交如，威如，吉。 为-治理：使人信从，激发主动，又有威仪，故而吉祥。 Governance / Maintain: One causes others to trust and follow, stirs their own initiative, and also bears dignity; therefore this is auspicious.

上九：自天祐之，吉，无不利。 宽宥：从天得到保佑，吉祥，没有不利。 Clemency / Retain: Help comes from heaven. Auspicious, with nothing unfavorable.

docs.title: 临卦
docs.text:
《临》 面对 (Confrontation) - 临视 (Oversight)

元亨，利贞。至于八月有凶。 大为通达，适宜正固。到了八月会有凶险。 Originally abundant and smooth; favorable to persist in rectitude. Come the eighth month, there will be misfortune. 参考义项：汛期（瀶，山谷水出）

《象》曰：泽上有地，《临》。君子以教思无穷，容保民无疆。 《象》传说：泽上有地，这就是临卦。君子因此竭力服务职守而不穷尽，劳苦安定百姓而不划分疆界。 The Xiang commentary says: Above the marsh is the earth; this is Lin. The noble one, accordingly, exhausts himself in service without end, and labors to settle the people without delimiting borders.

初九：咸临，贞吉。 守卫：函守，贞正则吉祥。 Guard: Contained; persevering brings auspiciousness. 《象》曰："咸临贞吉"，志行正也。 《象》传说："咸临贞吉"，是说志向践行端正。 The Xiang commentary says: "Fully felt approach; persevering brings auspiciousness" means the will moves in rectitude.

九二：咸临，吉，无不利。 碰上/攻伐：共同、减伤，吉祥，没有什么不利。 Encounter: Together, one reducing another; auspicious, nothing is disadvantageous. 《象》曰："咸临吉无不利"，未顺命也。 《象》传说："咸临吉无不利"，是说不顺从命运。 The Xiang commentary says: "Fully felt approach; auspicious, nothing is disadvantageous" means not yet submissive to the command.

六三：甘临，无攸利；既忧之，无咎。 照耀：酣畅，无所利益；既然忧虑它，就没有错咎。 Shine: Being uninhibited, brings no benefit; once one worries about it, there is no blame. 《象》曰："甘临"，位不当也。"既忧之"，"咎"不长也。 《象》传说："甘临"，位置不恰当。"既忧之"，是说咎害不会长久。 The Xiang commentary says: "Greedy approach" means the position is inappropriate. "Once one worries about it" means the "blame" will not endure.

六四：至临，无咎。 给予：给与（以）质询，没有错咎。 Giving/Probing: Questioning; there is no blame. 《象》曰："至临无咎"，位当也。 《象》传说："至临无咎"，位置恰当。 The Xiang commentary says: "Direct approach; there is no blame" means the position is appropriate.

六五：知临，大君之宜，吉。 临摹：记录，大君的适宜，吉祥。 Copying: Recording—appropriate for the great ruler; auspicious. 《象》曰："大君之宜"，行中之谓也。 《象》传说："大君之宜"，是说践行中道。 The Xiang commentary says: "Appropriate for the great ruler" means practicing the Mean.

上六：敦临，吉，无咎。 监理：敦促，吉祥，没有错咎。 Supervision: Urging; auspicious, there is no blame. 《象》曰："敦临"之"吉"，志在内也。 《象》传说："敦临之吉"，是说志向在内。 The Xiang commentary says: The "auspiciousness" of "sincere approach" means the will is directed inward.

docs.title: 坤卦
docs.text:
《坤》 循顺 (Follow/Sexton) - 巡察 (Patrol/Surveyor)

元亨。利牝马之贞。君子有攸往，先迷后得主。利西南得朋，东北丧朋。安贞吉。 大通亨达。利于如牝马那样柔顺而守正。君子有所前往，开始迷失，后来找到主导者(便能得其常道)。往东南西北四方出走（巡狩），得到或失去钱财，安定、安抚（百姓），吉。 Great flourishing and free passage. It is favorable to be gentle and steadfast like a mare. If the noble one has somewhere to go, going first on his own is easy to lose the way; afterward, he can find the master as the constant course. Going east, south, west, or north, he may gain or lose wealth to bring stability and to soothe the people, auspicious. 参考义项：驯顺，天子巡狩。

《象》曰：地势坤，君子以厚德载物。 承载、运载：大地之势柔顺而广厚，这就是坤。君子因此庆赏丰厚，巡察众人。 Bears and Carries: The earth's configuration is yielding and broad; this is Kun. Therefore the noble one bestowed generous rewards and inspected the people.

初六：履霜，坚冰至。 谨慎：脚下已踏到霜，就知坚冰将至。 Prudent / Sequel: Treading on frost, one knows that hard ice is on the way.

六二：直、方、大，不习，无不利。 安定：正直方正，光大宏大，领受，无所不利。 Stability / Obsequious: Upright and square, bright and grand; in receiving, nothing is unfavorable.

六三：含章，可贞。或从王事，无成有终。 放纵：容忍显著（恶行），应该匡正。若放纵王的政事，没有成功，只能去死。 Indulgence / Sequence: Tolerating blatant (wrongdoing, which) should be corrected. If the king's affairs are left unchecked and not accomplished, death is the only outcome.

六四：括囊，无咎无誉。 柔顺：包容敛藏，因此无咎亦无誉。 Gentleness / Subsequent: Enclose and store things away; thus there is neither blame nor praise.

六五：黄裳，元吉。 训导：黄色坐裳，故大吉。 Instruction / Consequence: A yellow lower garment (to convey pride and purpose); great auspiciousness.

上六：龙战于野，其血玄黄。 降服：龙在天际战栗，流赤黑、明黄色的血。 Subjugation / Exequy: The dragon trembles at the edge of the sky, shedding dark-red and bright-yellow blood.

用六：利永贞。 通六 顺从：利于长久守正。 All Six (Compliance): It is favorable to remain steadfast over the long term.

docs.title: 观卦
docs.text:
《观》 观阙 (Watchtower) - 台榭 (Terrace-Spectacle)

盥而不荐。有孚颙若。 洗手灌祭而不献上牲牢。肃敬的样子使人信从。 Wash hands for the libation but do not present the sacrificial offerings. Reverent demeanor inspires compliance. 参考义项：灌祭（祼礼）

《象》曰：风行地上，《观》。先王以省方观民设教。 《象》传说：风行在地上，这就是观卦。先王因此省视四方、观察民情、设立教令。 The Xiang commentary says: The wind moves over the earth; this is Guan. The former kings, accordingly, inspected the regions, observed the people, and established edicts.

初六：童观，小人无咎，君子吝。 勤勉：劳作操持，小人没有错咎，君子有鄙吝。 Diligence: Labor and management; for the petty person there is no blame, but for the noble one there is regret. 《象》曰："初六童观"，"小人"道也。 《象》传说："初六童观"，是小人的道。 The Xiang commentary says: "The bottom six, childlike observation" is the way of the petty person.

六二：窥观，利女贞。 观察：窥看，利于女子占卜。 Observation: Peeping observation; favorable for a woman's divination. 《象》曰："窥观女贞"，亦可丑也。 《象》传说："窥观女贞"，也是可丑的。 The Xiang commentary says: "Peeping observation; favorable for a woman to persevere" can also be shameful.

六三：观我生，进退。 借鉴/鉴戒：观察我，反省，进退。 Benchmark / Reflection: Observe and examine myself; advance or withdraw. 《象》曰："观我生进退"，未失道也。 《象》传说："观我生进退"，没有失去正道。 The Xiang commentary says: "Observe my own life; advance or withdraw" means not having lost the Way.

六四：观国之光，利用宾于王。 辅助：鼓励国家的宽宏，利于做君王的宾客。 Assistance: Encourage the state's broad-mindedness; favorable to serve as a guest to the king. 《象》曰："观国之光"，尚"宾"也。 《象》传说："观国之光"，推崇"宾客"。 The Xiang commentary says: "Observe the splendor of the realm" means esteeming the "guest."

九五：观我生，君子无咎。 示范：借鉴我，赞许，君子没有错咎。 Exemplarity: Borrow from me, approve; for the noble one there is no blame. 《象》曰："观我生"，观民也。 《象》传说："观我生"，是说观察人民。 The Xiang commentary says: "Observe my own life" means observing the people.

上九：观其生，君子无咎。 劝导：辅助他省悟，君子没有错咎。 Exhortation: Assist him to awaken; for the noble one there is no blame. 《象》曰："观其生"，志未平也。 《象》传说："观其生"，是说志向尚未平定。 The Xiang commentary says: "Observe others' lives" means the will is not yet content.

docs.title: 剥卦
docs.text:
《剥》 襁褓(Swaddle Cloth) - 服马 (Wheel Horse)

不利有攸往。 不利于主动前往做事。 It is not favorable to take the initiative and go forward with affairs. 参考义项：停殡（仆/朴）

《象》曰：山附于地，《剥》。上以厚下安宅。 厚待：山贴附在地上，这就是剥卦。居上位的人以此后离开，遏止（军队）分崩离析。 Generous treatment: The mountain clings to the earth; this is Bo. Therefore, those above use this to bring up the rear during a withdrawal, stopping (the army) from falling apart.

初六：剥床以足蔑，贞凶。 负-依凭：击打床坐来制止轻蔑，这样下去会有凶险。 Reliance / Suppose: Strike the seat to check contempt; if this continues, there will be danger.

六二：剥床以辨蔑，贞凶。 朴实：掊挖底部来辨明污蔑，这样下去会有凶险。 Plainness / Propose: Dig into the base to identify slander; if this continues, there will be danger.

六三：剥之，无咎。 驳-相异：背离它，没有错咎。 Divergence / Compose: Deviate from it; there is no blame.

六四：剥床以肤，凶。 服-承担：依凭于床来仆服，凶险。 Bearing / Depose: Rely on the bed to lie prostrate; this is dangerous.

六五：贯鱼以宫人，宠，无不利。 服御：射中鱼靠宫人，宠劳，没有不利。 Harnessing / Dispose: Shooting fish relies on palace attendants; bestowing favor, brings no disadvantage.

上九：硕果不食，君子得舆，小人剥庐。 裸露：如大果子还没有被吃掉。君子（暴露）能得到车可乘载，小人却如同把自己的房屋也剥除了。 Denudation / Expose: It is like a large fruit not yet eaten. The noble one can obtain a carriage to ride in, while the petty person strips away even his own hut.

docs.title: 复卦
docs.text:
《复》 肚腹 (Incubator) - 夹衣 (Lined Garment)

亨。出入无疾。朋来无咎。反复其道，匕曰来复。利有攸往。 参考义项：复魂（覆/復） 翻译：通达。往来都没有灾病，朋友来了，没有过错。人回魂则回到正道上；(否则)用木匙承载牲体，是要使之颠倒。适合有所前往。 英文：Smooth. Coming and going brings no illness. Friends arrive without fault. When the soul returns, one returns to the right path; (otherwise), carrying the sacrificial body with a wooden spoon is to overturn it. It is favorable to go forward. 希腊文图式：epistrophe 英文直译：return / turning back

《象》曰：雷在地中，《复》。先王以至日闭关，商旅不行，后不省方。 庀，治理：雷藏在地下，复卦。古代君王因此在冬至时关闭关口，使商旅不出行，君主也不巡察四方。 Governance: Thunder is hidden within the earth; this is Fu. Therefore, on the winter solstice, the former kings closed the passes, merchants and travelers did not go out, and the ruler did not inspect the four directions. 希腊文图式：kleisis 英文直译：closure

初九：不远复，无祗悔，元吉。 遏止：不远就归还，没有大的悔恨，大吉。 Curb: If one is returned without going far, there is no great regret. Great good fortune. 希腊文图式：metanoeo 英文直译：change one's mind / repent / turn back

六二：休复，吉。 覆庇：荫庇之复，吉祥。 Shelter / Consist: As the protection of shade, auspicious. 希腊文图式：splagchnizomai 英文直译：be moved with compassion / be sheltered in mercy

六三：频复，厉，无咎。 宽宥：以宾客相待之复，虽然有危险，但还不至于有过错。 Leniency: Treating someone as a guest carries danger, yet it does not amount to fault. 希腊文图式：apheimi 英文直译：release / let go / forgive

六四：中行独复。 重复：适合巡视审慎考求。 Iteration / Persist: It is suitable to make inspections and careful inquiries. 希腊文图式：kaleo 英文直译：call / summon

六五：敦复，无悔。 覆盖：覆焘之复，所以没有悔恨。 Cover: As covering over, it brings no regret. 希腊文图式：karpos / perisseuo 英文直译：fruit / abound

上六：迷复，凶，有灾眚。用行师，终有大败，以其国君，凶，至于十年不克征。 刚愎：沉迷，结果凶险，又有灾祸。若以此出兵，最终大败，罢黜国君，有凶祸，长期都不能取胜。 Obstinacy: Delusion is ominous and brings calamity. If one sends out troops, there will ultimately be great defeat, deposing the ruler, there will be misfortune, and for a long time there will be no success in campaigns. 希腊文图式：sklerokardia 英文直译：hardness of heart

docs.title: 习坎卦
docs.text:
《习坎》 反复炼 (Repetition Training) - 惯囚槛 (Institutionalizing)

习坎：有孚维心，亨。行有尚。 翻译：真诚，只有中心，通达。行为有常法。 英文：Sincerity, center alone, free passage. Actions follow routines. 参考义项：瘗埋/简练

《象》曰：水洊至，习坎。君子以常德行，习教事。 训练：水流相续而至，这就是习坎。君子以此崇尚德行，训练教化之事。 Training: Water flows continuously, one after another; this is The Abyss. The noble one thereby reveres virtue and trains in matters of education.

初六：习坎，入于坎窞，凶。 陷落：练习挖坑，却跌入深坑，凶险。 Submersion / Trouble: Practicing excavation, yet falling into deep pits; there is misfortune.

九二：坎有险，求小得。 坎壈：坑中有险阻，寻求小有所得。 Rugged / Traverse: The pit contains perils; one seeks small gains while enduring compression.

六三：来之坎坎，险且枕，入于坎窞，勿用。 掘坑：来时咣咣（挖坑），艰难且深陷，落入坎坑深处，不可有所作为。 Excavation / Trench: Came to dig with a thud, perilous and sinking deep; falling into the depths of the pit. one cannot take action.

六四：樽酒簋贰用缶，纳约自牖，终无咎。 欿-不自满：一樽酒、两簋食，使用瓦器盛装，通过窗户放进绳子。终无过错。 Hollow / Trough: One vessel of wine, two baskets of grain, using earthenware containers, delivering it with rope through the window. ultimately there is no blame.

九五：坎不盈，祗既平，无咎。 敛藏：瘗坎不盈满，（填埋后的）土坻仅得持平，无过错。 Containment / Tempering: The sacrificial pit is not filled; the earthen mound after burial is merely level; there is no blame.

上六：系用徽纆，寘于丛棘，三岁不得，凶。 忧恨：被绳索捆绑，放置在荆棘丛中，三年不得解脱，凶险。 Remorse / Tribulation: Bound with ropes and placed among thorns; unable to escape for three years. there is misfortune.

docs.title: 夬卦
docs.text:
《夬》 抉择 (Strategic Choice) - 决断 (Definitive Judgment)

扬于王庭，孚号。有厉，告自邑，不利即戎，利有攸往。 举扬（弓箭）于王庭之上，符合记号。有危厉，从城邑求告，不宜立即动武。利于有所前往。 When Breakthrough manifests, raising the bow in the royal court, matching the signal. There is danger—petition from your own city; it is not advantageous to immediately resort to arms, but it is advantageous to have somewhere to go. 参考义项：抉择/决断。校场选拔；开战决断。

《象》曰：泽上于天，《夬》。君子以施禄及下，居德则忌。 弛-舍弃：泽水上越于天，这是夬卦。君子因此散布俸禄给下民，而囤积所得则有所顾忌。 Letting go: The marsh rises above heaven; this is Guai. The noble one extends benefits to those below, but hoarding virtue invites misgivings.

初九：壮于前趾，往不胜，为咎。 废弛：撞到前趾，前往却不能胜任，咎过。 Decrepitude: Hitting the front toes, going forth yet not competent—this is blame.

《象》曰："不胜"而"往"，"咎"也。 "不胜"而"往"，是"咎"。 "Unable to prevail" yet "going forth"—this is "blame."

九二：惕号，莫夜有戎，勿恤。 判断：警惕呼号，寂静的夜里（因兵戎）集结，无须忧虑。 Judgment: A call to arms is sound; gathering in the quiet of the night (due to war)—no need to worry.

《象》曰："有戎勿恤"，得中道也。 "有戎勿恤"，因为得守中道。 "Gathering, no need to worry" because one holds to the middle way.

九三：壮于頄，有凶。君子夬夬独行，遇雨若濡，有愠无咎。 决裂：颧骨强壮，有凶险。君子刚决独行，遇雨如沾湿，虽有愠怒但无咎过。 Severance: Strong in the cheekbones, there is danger. The noble one makes his decision alone, encounters rain as if wet, though resentful, there is no blame.

《象》曰："君子夬夬"，终"无咎"也。 "君子夬夬"，终将"无咎"。 "The noble one makes his decision alone," ultimately "there is no blame."

九四：臀无肤，其行次且。牵羊悔亡。闻言不信。 果决：臀部无肤，行走艰难。牵羊则悔恨消亡。听责言而不信服。 Resoluteness: The buttocks are without flesh, walking is difficult. Leading the sheep, regret vanishes. Hearing reproachful words yet not submitting.

《象》曰："其行次且"，位不当也。"闻言不信"，聪不明也。 "其行次且"，位置不当。"闻言不信"，听力好但不明智。 "Walking is difficult," the position is improper. "Hearing words yet not believing," the hearing is good but not wise.

九五：苋陆夬夬中行，无咎。 決骤：山羊跳跃前行，果断中行，无咎过。 Run Wild: The goat jumps forward, decisive in the middle path, there is no blame.

《象》曰："中行无咎"，中未光也。 "中行无咎"，中道尚未光显。 "No blame in the middle path," the middle way is not yet fully manifest.

上六：无号，终有凶。 诀别：不要哭嚎，朋友众多，凶险。 Parting: Do not wail, (since you have) many friends, there is danger.

《象》曰："无号"之"凶"，终不可长也。 "无号"之"凶"，众人不可长久。 "The misfortune of no wailing", the many cannot last forever.

docs.title: 姤卦
docs.text:
《姤》 钩梯 (The Hook Ladder) - 鱼钩 (The Fish Hook)

女壮，勿用取女。 嫁女时装扮她。不可用（花言巧语勾着够不着的）来娶妻。 Dress her up for her wedding. Don't use (sweet talk to seduce someone you can't reach) to marry her. 参考义项：阿谀嫁娶，巧言令色。诟，花言巧语。

《象》曰：天下有风，《姤》。后以施命诰四方。 求告：天下有风，是姤卦之象。君主以此发布政令，宣告四方。 Petition: Wind under heaven, Encountering. The ruler proclaims orders to the four quarters.

初六：系于金柅，贞吉。有攸往，见凶，羸豕孚蹢躅。 邂逅：系于金属辖軎，贞正则吉，有所往。碰见，凶。瘦弱的猪浮躁不安，徘徊跳跃。 Encounter: Tied to a metal axle stopper, persistence brings fortune, going forth. Meeting, misfortunate. The lean sow leaps restlessly, pacing and wavering.

《象》曰："系于金柅"，柔道牵也。 "系于金柅"，柔弱之道受到牵引。 "Tied to a metal axle stopper," the soft way is restrained.

九二：包有鱼，无咎，不利宾。 谋求：聚集以渔取，无咎过，但不利于招待宾客。 Strategizing: Gathering to fish, no blame, but it is not suitable for entertaining guests.

《象》曰："包有鱼"，义不及"宾"也。 "包有鱼"，按义理不这样给予宾客。 "Gathering to fish," according to moral principles, this is not how guests should be treated (with calculation).

九三：臀无肤，其行次且，厉，无大咎。 遭遇：臀部无肤，行走艰难，有危险，但无大咎过。 Encountering: The buttocks are without flesh, walking is difficult—there is danger, but no great blame.

《象》曰："其行次且"，行未牵也。 "其行次且"，行走未被牵引。 "Walking is difficult," the movement is not guided.

九四：包无鱼，起凶。 求购：厨房中没有鱼，求取，凶。 Purchase: There is no fish in the kitchen—seeking to acquire, brings misfortune.

《象》曰："无鱼"之"凶"，远民也。 "无鱼"之"凶"，是远离民众的结果。 "The misfortune of having no fish" comes from keeping distance from the people.

九五：以杞包瓜，含章，有陨自天。 讲求：用杞柳包裹瓜果，包容防范，获得自天而陨落之物。 Hold fast: Wrapping melons with willow wood, inclusive and preventative, obtaining what falls from heaven.

《象》曰："九五含章"，中正也。"有陨自天"，志不舍命也。 "九五含章"，居中守正。"有陨自天"，其志愿不舍弃天命。 "Nine-five inclusive and preventative," it holds the center and correctness. "Something falls from heaven," its will does not abandon the mandate.

上六：姤其角，吝，无咎。 媾和：谋求角逐，有吝难，但无咎过。 Compromise: Strategically manage the competition, brings difficulty, yet there is no blame.

《象》曰："姤其角"，上穷"吝"也。 "姤其角"，居上而穷困，故生吝难。 "Strategically manage the competition," at the top and exhausted, thus arises difficulty.

docs.title: 困卦
docs.text:
《困》 梱：门橛 (Doorsill) - 閫：宫中道路 (Klotski)

亨。贞大人吉，无咎。有言不信。 通达。守正于大人之道则吉，无咎。虽有言辞、盟约，却难以取信。 Passage. Constancy in the way of the great person brings good fortune and no blame. Though there are words and pledges, they are hard to make trusted. 参考义项：门槛/困倦。围城；从因被困而得不到，到因得到而被困。

《象》曰：泽无水，《困》。君子以致命遂志。 实行：泽中无水，这是困卦。君子因此招致盟友，完成其志。 Execution: The marsh has no water; this is Kun. The noble one therefore summons allies and carries through the will.

初六：臀困于株木，入于幽谷，三岁不觌。 隐居：臀部被刑杖敲打，进入幽暗山谷，三年不得见。 Seclusion: The buttocks are beaten by a punishment rod; one enters a dark valley and is not seen for three years.

《象》曰：“入于幽谷”，幽不明也。 “入于幽谷”，是因为幽暗而不明。 "Entering a dark valley" means being shut in obscurity, without light.

九二：困于酒食，朱绂方来。利用享祀。征凶，无咎。 贫困：匮乏酒食，高贵的朱绂正赐予。利于举行享祀。出征则凶，但无咎。 Impoverishment: Wine and food are lacking; the noble with vermilion knee-cover is just bestowing. It is suitable to make offerings (to the people). To go on campaign is misfortune, yet there is no blame.

《象》曰：“困于酒食”，中有庆也。 “困于酒食”，是因为中位有可庆之事。 "Lacking wine and food" means there is celebration within the center.

六三：困于石，据于蒺藜，入于其宫，不见其妻，凶。 围困：被石头阻碍，抓着蒺藜。进入自己的宫室，却不会见其妻，凶。 Siege: Blocked by stone, grabbing onto thorny caltrops. One enters one's own dwelling but does not meet the wife. Misfortune.

《象》曰：“据于蒺藜”，乘刚也。“入于其宫，不见其妻”，不祥也。 “据于蒺藜”，是柔乘刚而失当。“入于其宫，不见其妻”，是不祥。 "Grabbing onto caltrops" means the soft rides upon the firm and is out of place. "Entering the dwelling and not seeing the wife" is inauspicious.

九四：来徐徐，困于金车，吝，有终。 疲惫：缓缓归来，在兵车之中睡觉，有吝难，朋友众多。 Exhausted: Coming slowly, asleep within the war chariot. There is regretful difficulty, yet many friends are present.

《象》曰：“来徐徐”，志在下也。虽不当位，有与也。 “来徐徐”，是志向在下。虽位置不当，仍有所应与。 "Coming slowly" means the intent is below. Though the position is not proper, there is still someone to join with.

九五：臲卼，困于赤绂，乃徐有说，利用祭祀。 困窘：处于不安危殆之中，又被赤绂礼服捆缚。随后渐渐有所解脱，利于祭祀。 Distress: Unsteady and precarious, bound by the red knee-cover as ritual dress. Then slowly there is release. It is suitable to make sacrifices (to the god).

《象》曰：“臲”，志未得也。“乃徐有说”，以中直也。“利用祭祀”，受福也。 “臲”，是志尚未得伸。“乃徐有说”，是因为中正而直。“利用祭祀”，是受福。 "Precarious" means the will has not yet been fulfilled. "Then slowly there is release" is due to central uprightness. "Useful to make sacrifices" means receiving blessing.

上六：困于葛藟，于臲卼，曰动悔有悔，征吉。 穷尽：（棺材）用葡萄藤捆着，与割鼻断足比较，于是触动愚昧，有悔意，出征有吉。 Exhaustion: The coffin is bound with grapevines and set against the choice of nose-cutting and foot-cutting; thereupon ignorance is stirred, remorse is present, and going on campaign brings good fortune.

《象》曰：“困于葛藟”，未当也。“动悔有悔”，吉行也。 “困于葛藟”，是尚未得当。“动悔有悔”，是吉祥的行动。 "Constrained by tangled vines" means things are not yet fitting. "ignorance is stirred, remorse is present" means the movement is auspicious.

docs.title: 井卦
docs.text:
《井》 房：箭筒 (The Quiver) - 水井 (The Water-Well)

改邑不改井，无丧无得。往来井井。汔至，亦未繘井，羸其瓶，凶。 迁改城邑而不改水井，无所丧失，也无所得益。往来之人井井有条。几乎到达，却还未把井绳下到井中，反而毁坏了水瓶，凶。 The settlement may be changed, but the well is not changed. There is no loss and no gain. Those who come and go remain ordered. Almost arriving, yet the rope has not reached into the well; the jar is damaged. Misfortune. 参考义项：迁邑，汲水、打井；可被汲取的给养作为开放的资源。

《象》曰：木上有水，《井》。君子以劳民劝相。 同僚：木上有水，这是井卦。君子因此劳勉百姓，劝导彼此辅助。 Colleagueship: Water above wood; this is Jing. The noble one labors with the people and encourages mutual assistance.

初六：井泥不食。旧井无禽。 摒弃：井被泥阻塞，不能饮水。旧陷阱荒废，没有擒获。 Abandonment: The well is blocked by mud and cannot be used for drinking. The old pitfall is abandoned and captures nothing.

《象》曰：“井泥不食”，下也。“旧井无禽”，时舍也。 “井泥不食”，是因处在最下。“旧井无禽”，是时势已舍弃它。 "The muddy well is not eaten from" because it is below. "The old well has no birds or game" because the time has cast it aside.

九二：井谷射鲋，瓮敝漏。 占据：井谷之中弹出蛤蟆，水瓮破敝而漏。 Occupation: In the well valley a frog springs out; the earthen jar is broken and leaks.

《象》曰：“井谷射鲋”，无与也。 “井谷射鲋”，是因为无人相与。 "Shooting small fish in the well valley" means there is no one to join with.

九三：井渫不食，为我心恻。可用汲，王明并受其福。 彷徨：井已疏通洁净，却仍无人取食，使我心中忧恻。若可用来汲取，王者结盟，则一同受其福。 Hessitation: The well has been cleared, yet no one drinks from it; this makes my heart ache. If it can be used for drawing water and the king forms an alliance, all will receive its blessing together.

《象》曰：“井渫不食”，行“恻”也。求“王明”，“受福”也。 “井渫不食”，所以行而有忧恻。求得“王明”，则能“受福”。 "The cleared well is not eaten from" means one proceeds with sorrow. Seeking "the king's alliance" means receiving blessing.

六四：井甃，无咎。 捍蔽：修砌井壁，无咎。 Shielding / Armor: Get the well lined and repaired. No blame.

《象》曰：“井甃无咎”，修井也。 “井甃无咎”，是修治水井。 "Get the well lined , no blame" means repairing the well.

九五：井洌寒泉，食。 释放：清冽如寒泉，饮用。 Release / Effluence: Clear and cold like a spring, adopted for drinking.

《象》曰：“寒泉”之“食”，中正也。 “寒泉”可以饮用，是因为中正。 That the "cold spring" can be drunk from is due to central correctness.

上六：井收勿幕，有孚元吉。 市井：井纠合绳索，不要遮盖，付与，大吉。 The Commons: The well gathers the rope together; do not cover it. Entrust and give it over. Great good fortune.

《象》曰：“元吉”在“上”，大成也。 “元吉”在上位，是大成之象。 "Great good fortune" at the top means great completion.

docs.title: 丰卦
docs.text:
《丰》 豊器 (Cornucopia) - 蒲草 (Rush)

亨。王假之。勿忧，宜日中。 通达。君王来到（其封国），不要忧虑，（菶菶绵延）正宜如日中天。 Success. The king comes to his fief. Do not worry; it is just right to be at high noon, with flourishing growth spreading in fullness. 参考义项：封邦建国，菶菶绵延；“王假之”兼有君王亲临与授予权柄两层意思。全卦写盛极之时，既光明炽盛，也潜藏遮蔽与转衰。

《象》曰：雷电皆至，丰。君子以折狱致刑。 多物：雷与电一齐来到，这就是丰。君子以此决断狱讼，施行（制止）刑罚。 Many Things: Thunder and lightning arrive together; this is Feng. Therefore the noble one decides lawsuits and carries out, or brings to a stop, punishments.

初九：遇其配主，虽旬无咎，往有尚。 满足：遇到相配的主人（女主人），虽然暂且委曲相从，也没有过错；前往会受到推重。 Contentment: One meets a matching host, a mistress of the house. Though one temporarily bends and accommodates, there is no blame; going on will bring esteem.

六二：丰其蔀，日中见斗。往得疑疾，有孚发若，吉。 大：扩大蔽障，正午却看见北斗。前往则遭人疑惧嫌怨；俘虏奔逃。吉。 Grandeur: The covering screen expands, yet the Northern Dipper is seen at noon. Going on brings suspicion, fear, and resentment; captives flee in alarm. Auspicious.

九三：丰其沛，日中见沫，折其右肱，无咎。 扩大：遮蔽大，正午只见微弱星光；如同折伤右臂，难以施用，但并非其本心之过。 Expansion: The obscuring cover grows large, and at noon only faint starlight can be seen. It is like the right arm being broken, leaving one unable to act, yet it is not a blameworthy fault.

九四：丰其蔀，日中见斗，遇其夷主，吉。 丰裕：（仍）在大的遮蔽之中，正午见斗；但遇到与自己平等相应的主者，因此得吉。 Affluence: Still within a great covering, one sees the Dipper at noon; yet one meets a lord who is equal and responsive, and so there is good fortune.

六五：来章，有庆誉，吉。 使丰足：犒劳彰明，于是有庆赏，也有声誉，吉。 Enrichment: Reward and distinction are brought forth clearly; thus there is celebration, honor, and good fortune.

上六：丰其屋，蔀其家，窥其户，阒其无人，三岁不觌，凶。 茂盛：扩大屋宇，家中却被遮蔽。向门内窥看，寂静得不见一人，久久不复相见，凶。 Luxuriance: The house is enlarged, yet the home itself is covered over. One peers through the doorway and finds a deep stillness with no one there; after long years there is no meeting again. Ominous.

docs.title: 旅卦
docs.text:
《旅》 札甲 (Lamellar Armour) - 稆穭 (Wildling)

小亨。旅贞吉。 小有通达。行旅之中，守持其正则吉。 Small success. In travel, if one keeps to what is right, there is good fortune. 参考义项：去国离家。此卦不主“大成”，而主异地求存中的谨慎、自持与暂时安顿。

《象》曰：山上有火，旅。君子以明慎用刑，而不留狱。 得力：山上有火，这就是旅。君子因此明察而谨慎地用刑，不使狱案久拖不决。 Gaining Force: There is fire on the mountain; this is Lu. Therefore the noble one uses punishments with clarity and caution, and does not let court cases drag on unresolved.

初六：旅琐琐，斯其所，取灾。 笨拙：细碎地讲述，失去适宜，因此自取其灾。 Clumsiness: One speaks in a petty and fragmented way, losing what is fitting, and thus brings disaster on oneself.

六二：旅即次，怀其资，得童仆，贞。 奉养：行旅之人就近住下，怀藏资财，又得到童仆可用；守正则可安。 Sustenance: The traveler settles into a lodging nearby, keeps his goods in his care, and gains a young servant to use; if he remains upright, he can be secure.

九三：旅焚其次，丧其童仆，贞厉。 众多：军队焚烧他的旅舍，（他）又失去童仆；即使守正，也有危险。 Multitude: The army burns his lodging, and he also loses his young servant; even if he holds to what is right, there is danger.

九四：旅于处，得其资斧，我心不快。 旅居：羁旅而暂处一地，也得到了资财器用，但我心中并不畅快。 Sojourn: One sojourns and temporarily stays in one place, and also obtains goods and tools, yet in my heart there is no gladness.

六五：射雉，一矢亡，终以誉命。 膂力：射中雉鸟，虽失一箭，最终却因此得到称誉与任命。 Prowess: One shoots a pheasant; though a single arrow is lost, in the end one gains praise and appointment because of it.

上九：鸟焚其巢，旅人先笑后号咷。丧牛于易，凶。 粗鲁：鸟焚其巢，旅人先前欢笑，后来却号啕痛哭；（如）在易地失去牛，凶。 Brutality: A bird burns its nest. The traveler first laughs, then later howls and weeps; it is like losing an ox in the land of Yi. Ominous.

docs.title: 巽卦
docs.text:
《巽》 願：倾慕 (Aspiration) - 归还 (Restitution)

巽：小亨。利有攸往，利见大人。 小亨通。利于有所前往，利于进见大人。 Small passage. Favorable for having somewhere to go, favorable for seeing the great man. 参考义项：倾慕/归还。愻，谦逊恭顺

《彖》曰：《巽》，说也。刚巽乎中正而志行。柔皆顺乎刚，是以"小亨，利有攸往，利见大人"。 《象》曰：随风，《巽》。君子以申命行事。 行-离开：风相随，巽卦之象。君子以之申诫命令，巡视兵士. Departing: Wind following wind, the image of Xun. The superior man uses it to issue warnings and inspect troops.

初六：进退，利武人之贞。 践履：进或退，利于武人的贞正。 Execution: Advancing or retreating, favorable for the warrior's correctness.

九二：巽在床下，用史巫纷若，吉，无咎。 卑顺：孙子放置在床，仆倒，任用各种各样的卜史、巫师，吉，没有咎错. Obedience: Placing the descendant on the bed, falling prostate, employing various diviners and shamans, auspicious, no blame.

九三：频巽，吝。 逊色：宾服，有吝惜。 Inferiority: Submitting, there is stinginess.

六四：悔亡，田获三品。 置办：悔恨消失，田猎获得三样东西。 Procurement: Regret vanishes, hunting yields three kinds of game.

九五：贞吉，悔亡，无不利，无初有终。先庚三日，后庚三日，吉。 恭顺：贞正有吉，悔恨消失，没有不利。没有开始而成就。在更替前后三日（恭顺），吉。 Deference: Correctness brings auspiciousness, regret vanishes, nothing unfavorable. No beginning but achievement. In the three days before and after the change, auspicious.

上九：巽在床下，丧其资斧，贞凶。 逃避：辞让主宰的坐位，离开，失去钱财，坚持有凶。 Evasion: Declining the master's seat, departing, losing wealth, persistence brings misfortune.

docs.title: 兑卦
docs.text:
《兑》 脱出 (Emergence) - 悦服 (Admiration)

兑：亨，利贞。 亨通，利于贞正。 Success, favorable for holding to the proper course. 参考义项：脱出/悦服

《彖》曰：《兑》，说也。刚中而柔外，说以"利贞"，是以顺乎天而应乎人。说以先民，民忘其劳。说以犯难，民忘其死。说之大，民劝矣哉！ 《象》曰：丽泽，《兑》。君子以朋友讲习。 冯-依凭：两泽相连，兑卦。君子以之结交朋友，训练演习. Dependence: Two marshes joined, the image of Dui. The superior man uses it to make friends and to train and drill.

初九：和兑，吉。 掺兑：掺和，吉祥。 Intermixture: Blending, auspicious.

九二：孚兑，吉，悔亡。 蜕变：莩甲，吉祥，悔恨消亡。 Metamorphosis: Sprouting, auspicious, regret vanishes.

六三：来兑，凶。 税予：赐予，凶。 Tribute: Bestowing, ominous.

九四：商兑未宁，介疾有喜。 锐气：商量沟通没有止息，凭借急烈强狠则有喜悦。 Venture: Deliberation without rest; relying on urgency and fierceness brings joy.

九五：孚于剥，有厉。 通侻：托付给服马，有危厉。 Unpretentious: Entrusted to the wheel horse, there is danger.

上六：引兑。 述说：陈述或争辩。 Articulation: Statements or Arguments.

docs.title: 涣卦
docs.text:
《涣》 ![[v2-7125f0cf6015e3d9129939537b9ade59~resize_0_q75.png]] 涣涣 (Gush) - 涣衍 (Spread)

亨。王假有庙。利涉大川，利贞。 通达。君王来到宗庙。适合涉过大河，适合守持正固。 Accomplishment. The king comes to the ancestral temple. It is fitting to cross the great river, and fitting to hold fast to what is right. 参考义项：（𡨡）宗庙祭礼。宗庙之中，先进行盛大仪式，再发扬传承精神。

《象》曰：风行水上，《涣》。先王以享于帝，立庙。 祭享：风吹行在水面上，这就是涣卦。古代君王以此祭享上帝，建立宗庙。 Sacrificial Offering: Wind moves across the surface of the water; this is Huan. Earlier kings adopted it to offer sacrifices to the High God and establish ancestral temples.

初六：用拯马壮，吉。 改换：用阉割的马，强壮，吉祥。 Malleability / Reflux: Use a gelded horse, strong and vigorous; auspicious.

九二：涣奔其机1，悔亡。 炳焕：璀璨华美的光明，悔恨消失。 Illuminated / Efflux: Brilliant and splendid radiance appears, and regret vanishes.

六三：涣其躬，无悔。 畔换：彪炳自身，没有悔恨。 Rampant / Superflux: One makes oneself illuminated, and there is no regret.

六四：涣其群，元吉。涣有丘，匪夷所思。 发散：种类鲜明，大吉。田垄离散，这不是平常人容易想到的。 Dispersion / Difflux: Distinct group; greatly auspicious. The field ridges scatter; this is not something ordinary people would readily think of.

九五：涣汗其大号，涣王居2，无咎。 呼唤：重要的号令涣畔猛悍，彪炳王的治理，没有过错。 Calling / Afflux: An important proclamation spreading rampantly like floods and fiercely like droughts, it illuminates the king's governance; there is no blame.

上九：涣其血，去逖出，无咎。 涣泮：发散他的血，使忧惧离去而脱出，没有过错。 Dissolution / Transflux: Disperse his blood, let dread depart and withdraw, and so break free; there is no blame.

docs.title: 注疏
docs.text:
1. 倒装句，机涣奔，机通几，是明的异体字；涣通焕，奔通贲，表示华美 ↩

  2. 汗通旱，第二个涣通焕。 ↩

docs.title: 节卦
docs.text:
《节》 竹节 (Bamboo-Node) - 符节 (Tally / Credential)

亨。苦节，不可贞。 通达。病痛结节，就不可以守为常道。 Success. A painful knotting sickness cannot be kept as a constant norm. 参考义项：疖子（小疮）。节不是一味收紧，而是立界、分流、适度。

《象》曰：泽上有水，《节》。君子以制数度，议德行。 节制、适宜：泽上蓄水，这就是节卦。君子因此制定数目度量，审议德行的边界。 Regulation and Fitness: Water stands stored above the marsh; this is Jie. Therefore the noble one sets numerical measures and deliberates the boundaries of conduct.

初九：不出户庭，无咎。 节度：不走出户庭，没有过错。 Regulation / Stricture: Do not go out of the household court; there is no blame.

九二：不出门庭，凶。 分明：不走出门庭，就有凶险。 Demarcation / Restrict: If one does not go out of the gate-court, there is danger.

六三：不节若，则嗟若，无咎。 管束：若不能适度，就会因此嗟叹。还不至于有咎。 Restraint / Constrict: If one cannot keep moderation, one will sigh in lament; it still does not amount to blame.

六四：安节，亨。 适度：安适之节，所以通达。 Moderation / Strictness: Ease within due measure, and therefore there is success.

九五：甘节，吉，往有尚。 证验：甘美而合宜的节，吉祥；前往会受到推重。 Verification / Instrict: Sweet and fitting due measure is auspicious; going forward will bring honor.

上六：苦节，贞凶。悔亡。 操守：竭力的自我压迫，固守下去就有凶险；但悔恨可亡。 Integrity / Overstrict: Strenuous self-oppression, persisting in it brings danger; yet regret can disappear.

docs.title: 中孚卦
docs.text:
《中孚》 衷心姇悦 (Heartfelt Felicity) - 适合发孚 (Aptly Germinating)

豚鱼吉，利涉大川，利贞。 猪鱼（䱐，江豚）吉祥。（衷心姇悦）利于渡涉大川。（适合发孚）利于保持。 Porcine fish (river dolphin) are auspicious. Favorable to cross great rivers (Heartfelt Felicity); favorable to maintain (Aptly Germinating). 参考义项：孕育，妊娠、哺乳；䱐，江豚；脬，膀胱

《象》曰：泽上有木，《中孚》。君子以议狱缓死。 名义的：泽上有木，这就是中孚卦。君子因此审议狱案，宽缓死刑。 Virtual: Wood above the marsh; this is Zhongfu. The superior man deliberates on legal cases and postpones executions.

初九：虞吉，有它不燕。 孵化：准备，吉祥。宽宥蜿蜒蛇行，而勿燕安逸乐。 Incubation: Preparation, auspicious. Condoning the slithering path, yet never settling for idle ease.

九二：鸣鹤在阴，其子和之。我有好爵，吾与尔靡之。 信任：鹤在隐蔽处鸣叫，其配偶与之应和。我有美酒，与你共饮。 Trust: A crane calls in hiding; its spouse responds. I have fine wine; I will drink with you.

六三：得敌，或鼓或罢，或泣或歌。 俘虏：获得敌人，有的击鼓，有的停歇；有的哭泣，有的歌唱。 Captivity: Capture the enemy; some drum, some stop; some weep, some sing.

六四：月几望，马匹亡。 付与：月亮已经望祭，丧失马匹。 Bestowal: The moon sacrifice is complete; the horses are lost.

九五：有孚挛如，无咎。 信用：使信从，如系联，没有过错。 Trustworthiness: To make people believe and follow, as if linked; no blame.

上九：翰音登于天，贞凶。 浮躁：鸡叫升于天，固守下去有凶险。 Levity: The chicken's crow ascends to heaven; perseverance brings misfortune.

docs.title: 小过卦
docs.text:
《小过》 短暂过往 (Fleeting Past) - 稍微超过 (Slightly Overshoot)

亨，利貞，可小事，不可大事。飛鳥遺之音，不宜上宜下，大吉。 通达，利于坚守。可以小办，不可大操大办。飞鸟留下的声音，不宜变大，宜于降低，将要吉祭。 Smooth and favorable to perseverance. Small matters may be be small-scale, not extravagant. The flying bird leaves its sound; it is not favorable to become large, but favorable to diminish. There will be ritual of Ji (Resumption of normal life from funeral). 参考义项：大祥（葬礼两年后恢复正常生活，饭食中可用调味品）

《彖》曰：小過，小者過而亨也。過以利貞，與時行也。柔得中，是以小事吉也。剛失位而不中，是以不可大事也。有飛鳥之象焉，有飛鳥遺之音，不宜上宜下，大吉；上逆而下順也。

《象》曰：山上有雷，小過；君子以行過乎恭，喪過乎哀，用過乎儉。 庸-更替：雷在山上，小过卦。君子因此行事过于恭敬，丧事过于哀痛，用度过于节俭。 Alternation: Thunder on the mountain constitutes Small Excess. The superior person, therefore, is more than respectful in conduct, more than grieving in mourning, and more than economical in expenditure.

初六：飛鳥以凶。 受祸：飞蝗成灾，有凶。 Receiving misfortune: Excessive locust swarms; there is danger.

六二：過其祖，遇其妣；不及其君，遇其臣；無咎。 前往：拜访祖父，遇见祖母；未达君王处，遇见臣子；没有过错。 Proceeding: Visiting one's grandfather and meeting one's grandmother; failing to reach the ruler but meeting the minister; there is no blame.

九三：弗過防之，從或戕之，凶。 责备：没有犯错就预防，若放纵可能伤害他，凶。 Reproach: One guards against fault before any error has occurred; if indulges, one may instead harm him; there is danger.

九四：無咎，弗過遇之。往厲必戒，勿用永貞。 过失：没有过错，不责备而礼遇他。过往的危厉必须警惕，不要长期固守。 Fault: There is no blame; one is not reproached but instead received with courtesy. The danger of the past must be kept in mind. Do not persist indefinitely.

六五：密云不雨，自我西郊，公弋取彼在穴。 经过：浓云密布却未降雨，从我西郊而来。王公射猎，在深穴中射取它（飞鸟）。 Passing by: Dense clouds form but no rain falls, coming from my western suburbs. The duke shoots and takes it (the bird) from deep cavity.

上六：弗遇過之，飛鳥離之，凶，是謂災眚。 作祸：未能求得而经过它，用网罗捕捉飞鸟，凶，这叫灾难罪过。 Creating calamity: Failing to meet, simply passed by—choosing instead to capture a flying bird with a net; there is danger. This is called disaster caused by fault.

docs.title: 既济卦
docs.text:
《既济》 既䍤-过滤 (Already Filtered) - 确定成功 (Ensured Success)

既济：亨。小利贞。初吉终乱。 既济：亨通，小心，宜于守正。在吉日朔日（斋戒），终将治理。 all proceeds. Careful, persistence is favorable. (Fasting) on the auspicious new moon, eventually bringing order. 参考义项：斋戒。

《象》曰：水在火上，《既济》。君子以思患而豫防之。 方正：水在火上，既济。君子由此伺察隐患并预先防堵。 Upright: Water rests upon fire; this is Settlement. The superior person, contemplating this, watches for potential calamities and guards against them in advance.

初九：曳其轮，濡其尾，无咎。 酌量：牵拉车牙，煣屈边缘，没有灾咎。 Tempering: Pull the wheel rim, bend the edge (with fire); no blame.

六二：妇丧其茀，勿逐，七日得。 听凭：妇人失去了车上的帷障，不必追赶，七日后自然会得回。 Permit: The woman loses her carriage curtain; do not pursue it—within seven days it will be restored.

九三：高宗伐鬼方，三年克之，小人勿用。 渡过：高宗征伐鬼方，三年才战胜，小人不可用此。 Overcome: King Wuding attacked the Ghost Regions; three years were required to conquer them. Petty persons should not employ this.

六四：有衣袽，终日戒。 忧愁：寒衣有破旧的衣絮，整日警戒。 Anxiety: Winter garments have worn-out cloth rags; vigilant all day.

九五：东邻杀牛，不如西邻之禴祭，实受其福。 斋-庄敬：东邻杀牛（盛祭），不如西邻的（简约）禴祭，真正受福。 Solemnity: The eastern neighbor slaughters an ox (grand sacrifice), yet it is not as good as the western neighbor's (simple) spring offering, which truly receives blessing.

上六：濡其首，厉。 排挤：濡滞其蹈履，危险。 Ostracizing: Clog their tread; danger.

docs.title: 未济卦
docs.text:
《未济》 未霽-阴郁 (Murkiness) - 不停 (Persistence)

未济，亨。小狐汔济，濡其尾，无攸利。 未济，亨通。小狐勉强渡河（从漩涡生还），（吓得）尿到尾巴：不适宜做事 When matters are unsettled, all proceeds. The little fox barely crossed the river (surviving the whirlpool), and (frightened) peed on its tail: unsuitable for doing anything. 参考义项：齐，通“ 臍 “，漩涡

《象》曰：火在水上，《未济》。君子以慎辨物居方。 改变：火在水上，未济。君子由此谨慎备办事物，攻克妨碍。 Change: Fire rests above water; this is Unsettled. The superior person, contemplating this, carefully prepares affairs and overcomes obstacles.

初六：濡其尾3，吝。 利用：烹煮尾巴，吝惜。 Exploitation: Boil the tail; Stingy.

九二：曳其轮4，贞吉。 整治：（弓檠）拴缚它的轮廓，守正则吉。 Rectification: (The bow's lintel) binds its outline, persistence brings good fortune.

六三：未济，征凶，利涉大川。 齐备充足：未成功，出征有凶，但利于涉越大川。 Redundancy: Unsettled, to advance brings misfortune, yet it is favorable to cross great rivers.

九四：贞吉，悔亡。震用伐鬼方5，三年有赏于大国。 跻-登上到达：守正则吉，悔恨消失。整治，征伐鬼方，三年后在大国受赏。 Ascension: Persistence brings good fortune, regret vanishes. Reorganizing, to attack the Ghost Regions; after three years, rewarded by the great state.

六五：贞吉，无悔。君子之光，有孚，吉。6 救济：守正则吉，没有悔恨。君子的宽广，使人信服，吉。 Redemption: Persistence brings good fortune, no regret. The superior person's breadth inspires trust; auspicious.

上九：有孚于饮酒，无咎。濡其首，有孚失是。7 增补助益：因饮酒有所辅助，没有灾咎。（但若）沾湿头发，（则）有所背离，（因）淫泆过甚。 Augmentation: It helps because of drinking wine; no blame. But if it soaks one's hair, then there will be adverse effects because of excessive indulgence.

  1. 尿到尾巴 狐狸受到惊吓或过度紧张时确实会尿到自己身上。这与犬科动物及猫科动物的“应激性尿失禁”类似，是因为恐惧激活了植物神经系统，导致膀胱括约肌不受控制地放松而排尿。 1, 2, 3 以下是关于狐狸与尿液的几个具体细节： - 尾巴构造：狐狸的尾巴非常粗大且敏感，上面分布着气味腺。 - 尿在尾巴上的机制：在极度害怕的情况下，狐狸会缩起尾巴或试图将身体蜷缩起来隐藏，这使得它们排出的尿液极易直接淋湿自己蓬松的尾巴。 ↩

  2. 妨碍，对应既济之方正， （雪桃）丘以为妨义，故不敢以先于宗庙之盛也。 ↩

  3. 同“ 胹 ”。謂以汁調和烹煮。 《禮記•少儀》： “羞濡魚者進尾；冬右腴， 夏右鰭；祭膴。” ↩

  4. 紲其轮，（弓檠）拴缚轮廓 曳通紲 3. 拴；縛。 《楚辭•離騷》： “朝吾將濟於 白水 兮， 登 閬風 而紲馬。” 4. 即竹製的弓檠。 弓卸去弦後縛在弓裡以防損傷的用具。 ![[Pasted image 20260523194339.png]] 说卦传，坎为弓轮 ↩

  5. 振，整治 ↩

  6. 子的宽广 《詩•魯頌•泮水》： “濟濟多士， 克廣德心。” 孔穎達 疏： “謂心德寬弘， 並無褊躁。” ↩

  7. 有副因饮酒，……，有负，泆甚 孚通副，表辅助 于表原因。《进学解》：“业精于勤，荒于嬉。” 附，用同“ 負 ”。 背棄；違背。 《敦煌曲子詞•望江南七》： “夜久更闌風漸緊， 為奴吹散月邊雲， 照見附心人。” 失通“佚”或“泆”。淫泆，放荡，放纵 [indulge in] 是用同“甚”。極，很。 ↩

docs.title: 师卦
docs.text:
《师》 军队 (Military) - 老师 (Mentor)

贞丈人吉，无咎。 翻译：坚守正道，任用贤明长者，吉利，没有过错。 英文：Maintain uprightness, employ wise elders, auspicious, no blame. 参考义项：军队 / 太师

《象》曰：地中有水，《师》。君子以容民畜众。 相容：大地中藏有水源，这就是师卦。君子用此革新百姓，培养兵众。 Compatibility: Water is stored within the earth; this is Shi. Therefore the noble one adopts this to renovate the people and cultivate the armed multitude.

初六：师出以律，否臧凶。 众多：军队出动要按照纪律，出言否定或赞同都凶险。 Multitude / Informed: When the army goes forth, it must follow strict discipline; speaking to negate or affirm is dangerous. 希腊文图式：eunomia 英文直译：good order / law-abiding

九二：在师中吉，无咎，王三锡命。 率领：拥戴忠厚和善的统帅，没有过错，君王三次赐予诏命。 Leadership / Reformer: Upholding a loyal and kind commander: no blame; the king grants edicts three times. 希腊文图式：typos 英文直译：pattern / example / mark

六三：师或舆尸，凶。 遵循：军队惑乱干预主持，凶险。 Capitulation / Deformation: The army in tumult meddles with the helm; ominous. 希腊文图式：spodas 英文直译：riot / clash

六四：师左次，无咎。 尊崇：将领佐助趋奉，没有过错。 Veneration / Conform: The commander flanked the left, attending with the utmost deference (of a disciple), there is no blame. 希腊文图式：parembole 英文直译：encampment

六五：田有禽，利执言，无咎。长子帅师，弟子舆尸，贞凶。 引导：田野中有擒获（俘虏），利于抓住而进行讯问，没有过错。长子统率军队，弟弟运载神主牌，保持这种状态会有凶险。 Conduct / Uniform: There are captives in the fields; it is favorable to seize and interrogate them, no blame. The eldest son leads the army with true command, the younger brother carries the spirit tablet; if this persists, there will be danger. 希腊文图式：mimesis 英文直译：imitation / emulation

上六：大君有命，开国承家，小人勿用。 表率：大君富有声名，开创拯救国与家，小人不要这样。 Exemplar / Transform: The great ruler is highly prestigious: to found and save states and houses; petty people should not act like this. 希腊文图式：hegemonia 英文直译：leadership / supremacy / command

docs.title: 比卦
docs.text:
《比》 篦顺 (Combing) - 矢栝 (Nocking)

吉。原筮元。永贞无咎。不宁方来，后夫凶。 翻译：吉利。推究占卜，行动情状体，长久守正无过错。（时局）不平静，正在招徕，迟来的有凶险。 英文：Auspicious. Examine the divination, situation aspect of activity, long-lasting uprightness has no blame. In turbulent times, currently inviting; those who come late face grave danger. 参考义项：太卜/朝会

《象》曰：地上有水，《比》。先王以建万国，亲诸侯。 亲近：地面上有水，这就是比卦。先王以此建立万国，更新诸侯。 Endearment: Water is on the earth; this is Bi. Therefore the earlier kings by this established ten thousand states and renewed the feudal lords.

初六：有孚比之，无咎。有孚盈缶，终来有它，吉。 治理：使人信从，聚集他们，没有过错。付出充满陶罐，众人来佑助他，吉利。 Regulation / Fitting: Make people trust and follow, gather them, no blame. Contributions fill the earthenware vessel; the multitude comes to assist him, auspicious. 希腊文图式：pistis 英文直译：faith / trust / confidence

六二：比之自内，贞吉。 效法：比照他们，接纳，坚持则吉利。 Imitation / Profit: Compare with them, and accept, if this persists, auspicious. 希腊文图式：mimetes 英文直译：imitator / follower

六三：比之匪人。 顺从：寄托于不当的人。 Subservience / Unfit: Entrusting oneself to the inappropriate people; this brings harm. 希腊文图式：parasitos 英文直译：hanger-on / toady

六四：外比之，贞吉。 配合：外人辅助他，坚持则吉利。 Alignment / Outfit: Outsiders assist him, if this persists, auspicious. 希腊文图式：symmaches 英文直译：ally / companion

九五：显比，王用三驱，失前禽，邑人不诫，吉。 亲和：和乐亲近，君王用三驱之礼，失掉前来的猎物，邑人不警诫，吉利。 Affinity / Benefit: Harmonious drawing near. The king uses the three-drive ritual, loses the game coming forward, the townspeople are not warned, auspicious. 希腊文图式：philia 英文直译：friendship / love / affection

上六：比之无首，凶。 勾结：无道地配合，凶险。 Collusion / Overfit: Aligning without principle, dangerous. 希腊文图式：sumphonia 英文直译：conspiracy / collusion
